newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Innovest suspended at company's request.
newsitem.headline: Innovest suspended at company's request.

text.p: Shares of property-based company Innovest Bhd, which topped the actives list in the morning session, were suspended from trading on Friday at the company's request, a Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange official said.
The company did not give any explanation for the suspension request, she said.

Innovest shares were the most actively traded in the morning session, rising 60 cents to 10.50 ringgit on volume of 20.29 million traded. Dealers said recent speculation in the overall market made it difficult to determine whether the shares had risen due to fundamental news or buying by retail investors.
